HeartGold & SoulSilver series · HS

HeartGold & SoulSilver

Released February 10, 2010 · 124 cards

HeartGold & SoulSilver is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the HeartGold & SoulSilver series, released in English on February 10, 2010. Its main set has 123 cards, plus 1 secret rare numbered beyond the set (124 in total). It includes 99 Pokémon, 15 Trainer and 10 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.

Illustrators

32 illustrators worked on HeartGold & SoulSilver. Most cards: Ken Sugimori (11), Masakazu Fukuda (9), Kagemaru Himeno (7), Midori Harada (6), Kent Kanetsuna (5), match (5), Yuka Morii (5), Hideaki Hakozaki (4).
